## Summary

[Partial] Trim excess U-bolt thread length and retorque after weight application. [t693]

Cut the swaybar brackets off to avoid interference with the leaf plate. [t693]

Check that the U-bolt threads are thick enough to handle higher torque than stock. [t693]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

## Specifications

- **Thread exposure**: 1/8-1/4" " [t693] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Retorque after a week with weight on the axle, then again about a month later. [t693]
- Ensure U-bolts are evenly tight to prevent constant loosening. [t693]
